title: A Godly Man Lets Himself Be Bored
caption:
The second things go quiet, you reach for the phone. That's not relaxation. That's avoidance with a screen.

Elijah didn't find God in the wind or the fire. He found Him in the still, small voice, after everything loud had already passed. You can't hear Him over your own noise.

Notice the urge to check it. Don't obey it. Build the muscle on an ordinary Tuesday, so it's there the day you actually need it.

#faith #discipline #christianmen #manofgod #stillness
